tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal grol ba'i thig le'i khrid yig mi shigs pa'i rin po che sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

<'di srog 'dzin dran ting bzhi yin pas rjes su bstan par bya'o//> na mo badzra ā tsarya akṣo bhyaḥ badzra mañdzu shri ye/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku// rtag brtan bde chen gzhon nu'i tshul/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje bla ma dang*/ /dbyer med de la gus pas 'dud/ /gang zag rnam pa bzhi'i don du/ /dga' bzhi thig le rnam bzhi'i lam/ /sku bzhi sgrub thabs rdzogs rim mchog /rton pa bzhi ldan bdag gis bshad/ /'dir 'phags pa 'jal dpal gyi zhal lung brnyes pas yang dag pa'i don mngon sum du gzigs pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje slob dpon mchog sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi bzhed pas/ skal dman tshe 'dir bskyed rim 'ba' zhig bsgoms te rdzogs rim skye ba gzhan du smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor ba dang*/ 'bring po tshe 'dir rdzogs rim gtso bor bsgoms pas bskyed rim zhor la 'grub ste/ bar do'am skye ba gzhan la byang chub pa'i lam dang*/ skal ldan bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu rgyas 'debs pa'i lam tshe 'di nyid la byang chub mngon du byed pa rdzogs pa chen po'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la ni/ slob dpon nyid kyis sgrub thabs kun bzang sogs mdzad la/ rgya bod kyi ye shes zhabs lugs pa phal cher zhig lam 'di nyid dang tshogs bshad tsam gyis chog shes can no/ /gnyis pa ni rdzogs rim nye tshe tsam yin la/ gsum pa ni lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa yin te/ lam gyi gnad rgyas par zhal lung dang grol thig las rtogs dgos shing*/ man ngag 'di dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rgyud kyi bshad pa ni/ slob bshad mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ 'on kyang rgya bod gnyis car du dkon par byung snang ngo*/ /des na 'dir nyams len 'khrid tshul ni rnam pa gsum ste/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i 'khrid/ mchog gyur dbang gi ye shes kyi 'khrid/ bla med grol ba'i thig le bsgom tshul lo/ /dang po gnyis zur du shes la/ gsum pa la sngar bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor yun ring du goms pa yin na/

'khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ma yin la/ de ltar ma yin na dgos pas bla ma snga ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar dgod par bya'o/ /de la 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro dang*/ 'khrid dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis te/ thun mong gi dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang*/ /'jig rten skye bo dam pa 'phrad rnyed dka'/ /de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yis/ /yid la byed pa'i mchog 'di bsgrub par bya/ /zhes pas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa'i rim pa bstan/ de bas chu 'khor drag po'i khar lhung ltar/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis brtson 'grus bskyed/ ces 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ /de la sngags pa snying rje'i stobs kyis ni/ /byang chub mchog tu yang dag sems bskyed cing*/ /gtong ba la sogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /zab mo'i tshul dag la ni lhag par mos/ / zhes pas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sgom pa spyod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa bskyed pa rnams bstan te/ de dag ni skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa dang thun mong yin pa'i phyir 'dir ma bshad do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las dang po ni/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro ba can gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ sgrub thabs su bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa la maṇḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bla ma mi bskyod rdo rje'am 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal btab ste/ mtha' skor du dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma khrom tshogs su bsgoms la/ dang por rtsa ba'i bla ma la maṇḍal lan bdun dang*/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs re re bzhin du maṇḍal lan re/ thams cad spyi mthun du maṇḍal lan bdun te/

maṇḍal lan re re'i mthar yang gsol ba drag tu gdab par bya'o/ /'di'i thog mtha' gnyis su maṇḍal lan bdun 'bul ba'i skabs su rgyal srid sna bdun re res zhing kun bkang ste 'bul ba'i dmigs pa dgos par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi mdun du/ seng ge'i khri'i gdan la bla ma rje btsun mi bskyod pa'am 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal btab la/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar dang*/ gzugs sogs rdo rje ma drug gi mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba lta bur phul la/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs kyis bstod cing 'jam rdor du bsgoms na/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /sogs kyis lan mang du gsol ba btab/ shes shing spro na/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste zhes sogs zhal lung nas 'byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis kyis gsol ba btab/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po la bdag gis lus dbul bar bgyi'o zhes rang nyid bran du 'bul/ slob dpon gyi sku las sku gnyis pa zhig chad nas rang nyid kyi spyi bor thim pas bum dbang thob par bsam/ sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyis 'od zer spros te mgrin par thim pas gsang dbang thob par bsam/ slar yang gsol ba drag tu btab pas bla ma spyi bor byon/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/ bdag nyid la thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam/ de nyid kyi ngang du dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa spangs te mnyam par 'jog pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o/ /'jug tu slar yang rjes su 'dzin par smon lam gdab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim gnyis las/ dang po la/ gang zag rab kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par sgom pa dang*/ 'bring gis dang po sbyor ba'am bsnyen sgrub yan lag chung ngu skor bzhi tsam sgom pa ste/ de gnyis ni sgrub thabs su shes par bya'o/

/dbang po dman pas shin tu bsdus pa'i rnal 'byor sgom tshul ni/ gzhung rnams las gsal bar ma 'byung yang bla ma'i man ngag go /de'i rim pa ni/ skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ tshad med bzhi spyi rigs pa btang nas/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ zhes stong pa nyid bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje ser sngo dkar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyis utpal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung kyis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zur phud lnga pa mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku can du gyur/ oṃ ngharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ mig gnyis su kṣiṃ dkar po sa snying*/ rna ba gnyis su dziṃ sngon po phyag rdor/ snar khaṃ ser po nam snying*/ lcer gaṃ dmar po spyan ras gzigs/ dpral bar kaṃ ljang khu sgrib sel/ lte bar saṃ sngon po kun bzang*/ snying gar hūṃ thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥgasung rdo rje/ dpral bar oṃ sku rdo rje/ sangs rgyas thams cad thugs gsung sku rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ snying gar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ral gri'i yu ba la maṃ/ dbang gi lha mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu sgrol ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/

/oṃ badzrir bha wa a bhi ṣi ñtsa hūṃ zhes dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ lha sku gsal stong la cung zad mnyam par bzhag cing*/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ zhes ci nus bzla/ yang na hūṃ dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ phyag drug dang po sngar dang 'dra lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo padma/ rang 'od kyi yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma rang 'dras 'khyud pa bsgoms/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje lte bar hūṃ yin gzhan thams cad rigs 'gre'o/ /'di ni rdzogs rim gyi rten tsam du gyur pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ dga' ba bzhi'i rim pa'am/ thig le bzhi'i rim pa'am thig le dang*/ ye shes dang 'pho ba'i rim pa ste gsum du bsdus kyang rung mod kyi/ 'dir tshe 'di la 'tshang rgya ba'i lam dang*/ bar dor 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gnyis las/ dang po la/ sngon 'gro thig le gsum gyi rnal 'byor/ dngos gzhi ye shes sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor/ rjes zab gsal gnyis med kyi spyod pas bogs 'byin pa ste gsum las/ dang po la/ snying gar mi shigs thig le dga' ba'i rnal 'byor/ gsang bar nor bu'i thig le mchog dga'i rnal 'byor/ sna rtser sprul ba'i thig le khyad dga'i rnal 'byor ste gsum las/ dang po la/ rtog pa can dang*/ rtog med gnyis las dang po la dmigs pa dngos dang*/ bogs 'don gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid bsrung 'khor gyi nang du chud pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bsgoms te lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rnams rgyud sde spyi dang mthun par rags pa tsam thog mar gsal gdab/ yi ge gsal 'debs mi dgos/ de'i rgyun la rtsa 'khor gzhan sgom mi nus na snying ga'i 'khor lo kho na bsgoms gzhan rnams mos pa tsam bya'o/ /de nas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su/

rang dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' yum dang bcas pa gsal btab/ de'i thugs kar ral gri sngo bsangs yu ba sbubs stong du gnas pa'i nang du maṃ dmar ser/ de la sems drag tu gtad pas/ maṃ yi ge 'od du zhu ste/ thig le dmar ser tsa na ka ste sran chung gi 'bru tshad tsam du gyur/ de la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag mi bskyod pa bsgoms pa yin na rdo rje dang hūṃ yig dang thig le sngon po bsgom pa ni khyad par te 'dis 'chad par 'gyur ba thams cad la rigs 'gre'o/ /dmigs skor dang po'o/ /de la brtan pa thob na/ de'i dbus su yang 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa bsgom pa ni/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /de las rten gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gtso rkyang bsgom pa ni/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /'khor gyi lha rnams kyang bsgoms pa ste/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /gtso bo sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su sngar bshad pa ltar bsgom pa ni/ dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /de'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' thig le'i nang du yang gtso bo tsam sgom pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang sgom pa dang*/ 'khor gyi lha rnams sgom pa dang*/ gtso bo sems dpa' gsum brtsegs sgom pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' maṃ yig zhu nas thig ler bsgom pa ste/ de lnga re re la dmigs skor re re ste bcu'o// 'di dag kyang dbang po rab gsal snang mthar phyin pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ da ltar bsgoms pa la ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par thig le'i nang du 'char dka' bas/ 'khor dang gzhal yas khang gi dmigs skor bzhi po dor te/ snying ga'i thig le'i rtsa ba la dmigs skor drug bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ gzhan don bsgrub pa'i phyir sbyang ba/ bde ba bskyed pa'i phyir bsdu ba/ byin rlabs 'jug pa'i phyir bskul ba ste gsum las dang po ni/ sngar bzhin snying gar sems dpa' gsum brtseg gi thig le bsgoms te/ de las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phros pa'i rtse mo la dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa sprul/

phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab ste/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod/ de rnams bdud rtsir zhu/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyang bdud rtsi la thim/ tshur 'dus te sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ snying ga'i thig le la thim pas/ yon tan bskyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan zhing*/ 'od zer 'bar bar bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni thig le'i 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa'i sku gang*/ de las 'od 'phros gzhi lus kyi nang gsal zhing gang bar byas/ mun khung du sgron me bteg pa ltar dkar cha thig le bcu drug po rnams gsal bar mthong ba ni/ rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis su a thung re/ byin pa gnyis su ā ring po re/ brla gnyis su i thung re/ gsang ba'i g.yas g.yon du ī ring po re/ gsus pa'i 'og gi g.yas g.yon du u thung re/ gsus pa'i steng gi g.yas g.yon du ū ring bo re/ nu ma g.yas g.yon gnyis la ṛ thung re/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi rtsa bar ṝ ring po re/ mgrin pa'i g.yas g.yon du l̥ thung re/ mchu'i thad kyi 'gram pa g.yas g.yon du l̥̄ ring po re/ 'gram pa'i dbus kyi g.yas g.yon du e 'greng bu rkyang pa re/ mig gnyis su ai 'greng bu nyis brtseg re/ rna ba gnyis su o na ro rkyang pa re/ spyi gtsug gi g.yas g.yon gnyis su au na ro nyis brtseg re/ tshigs thams cad la aṃ aḥre/ thams cad kyang kha dog dkar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ bde ba'i rang bzhin can du bsam/ snying ga'i 'od kyis yi ge de rnams rim pas sam cig car gang mos kyis snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i thig ler bstims pas/ 'od zer 'bar zhing*/ bde ba'i ngo bo lhag par rgyas par bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ snying ga'i thig le'i 'od kyis gzhi lus gsal ba'i bar gong bzhin las/ 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros te/ rtse mo la dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa sprul/ phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad khyab/

sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku'i drung du sleb pa na byang chub kyi sems kyi thig ler zhu/ rgyal ba yab yum rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi blangs/ yab kyi rdo rje dang*/ yum gyi padmar byung*/ gsang ba'i lam nas phyir byon pa na tshur 'dus/ yab kyi bdud rtsi rnams rang gi sna bug g.yas dang*/ yum gyi bdud rtsi rnams sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ rtsa ba'i thig le la thim pa dang*/ thig le de nyid dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ 'od zer cher 'bar bar bsam/ de rnams bsgoms pa las/ ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog cing*/ dpe'i 'od gsal gyi rtags 'dar ba dang smyo ba sogs 'byung zhing*/ phung khams kyi dri ma rags pa ci rigs pa dag cing*/ dga' ba'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa rtog med ni rtsa ba'i dmigs pa de 'jur ba yun thung tsam re sngon 'gror btang*/ sems kyi gtad so snying gar byas la mi rtog par bzhag pas/ thig le la gzhi byas pa'i rtogs snang*/ mtha' yas pa 'char pa la mnyam par 'jog ste dmigs pa dang po yin la/ de las stong pa'i ye shes gtso bor 'char ba dang*/ lte bar bsgoms pas sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ spyi bor bde ba dang*/ mgrin pa gsal ba'i ye shes skye ba yin no/ /des rtsa phran rnams kyi rlung thim pa dang*/ des drangs nas thig le 'du ba dang*/ rtsa ba'i rlung chen po rnams kyang dbu mar sdud pa 'byung ste sbyangs bsdus bskul gsum gyi brdas mtshon pa'i don no// de ltar na/ snying ga'i thig le dmigs chen dngos gcig yin pa la/ nang tshan dmigs skor drug gam bcu/ bogs 'don gyi dmigs chen gsum ste kun dril bas dmigs chen bzhi la dmigs skor dguu 'am bcu bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa la/ dmigs pa dngos dang*/ mthar 'byin byed gnyis las/ dang po la yang rtog pa can dang*/ rtog med gnyis kyi dang po ni/ snying ga'i thig le sngar bzhin bsgoms gong gi sbyangs bsdus bskul gsum po yud tsam dran par byas la/

dngos kyi rig ma'am ye shes kyi phyag rgya la mnyam par sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis rjes su chags pa'i mes snying ga'i thig le de nyid 'bar zhing zhu ste cha gsum du song*/ ro rkyang dbu ma gsum gyi lam la brgyud nas mas snar babs/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo las brgyud de rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo'i nang du babs pa/ rang lha'i phyag mtshan ste/ rdo rje'am ral gri sngo sangs nas 'bru tsam du gyur pa'i yu bar hūṃ ngam maṃ las byung ba'i thig le sngon po'am dmar ser yungs 'bru tsam la sems drag tu gzung ste dmigs skor gcig thig le'i dbus su gtso bo sgom pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang yang sgom pa dang*/ 'khor gyi lha rnams kyang sgom pa dang*/ de'i gtso bo'i thugs kar sems dpa' gsum brtseg sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' thig ler zhu ba sgom pa dang*/ thig le de'i dbus su yang gtso bo sgom pa dang/ gzhal yas khang sgom pa dang/ 'khor gyi lha rnams sgom pa dang*/ yang de'i gtso bo'i thugs kar sems dpa' gsum brtseg gi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' thig ler zhu ba sgom pa ste/ dmigs skor dgu'am/ 'dir yang 'khor dang*/ gzhal yas khang gi dmigs pa gnyis gnyis dor bas/ lngar byas kyang rung ngo*/ /las dang po pas 'khor dang gzhal yas khang gi dmigs pa 'dor tshul 'og ma rnams la'ang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa rtog med kyi rnal 'byor yang snga mas rigs 'gre ste/ rtog bcas de sngon 'gror tshar gcig btang nas/ nor bur rtog med la ring du mnyam par 'jog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ gegs sel dga' bral sgom pa dang*/ bogs 'don yan lag gsum sgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar nor bur thig le sgom pa de gnas dma' bas sems bying pa yang srid/ thig le phra ba dang 'od 'tsher ba sogs kyis rgod pa yang srid pas/ bying rgod kyi skyon gang byung yang*/ yid kyi dmigs pas thig le de nyid phyir spros te/ shes rab ma'i padma'i sna rtser gnas pa la sems drag tu gzung bas/

mchog dga' las langs te dga' bral gyi ye shes 'char bas de la dmigs pa'i bde stong bsgom par bya'o/ /bying rgod sel ba na/ slar yang thig le de nyid rang gi mas snar drangs/ gong bzhin sbyangs bsdus bskul gsum byas pas ye shes mchog skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rtog med kyi phyogs la rtags snang nor bu nas phyi rol tu 'phro ste yang de nyid rlung drag tu 'dren pas lus kyi nang du rtags snang 'char bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ dbugs dgag stong pa'i yan lag rtags snang gzung ba'i yan lag lha snang rjes dran gyi yan lag ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ snga ma bzhin du nor bur thig le bsgoms/ thig le'i 'od kyis ral gri'i yu ba nas brtsams te/ nor bu'i thig le'i phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor rim pa gnyis dang*/ gzhi lus phyi'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa gsal bar byas/ 'od zer tshur bsdu ba dang lhan cig phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor rnams rim gyis mtha' nas yal te/ mthar thig le gcig pu la sems gzung*/ rlung bum pa can drag tu dgag par bya ste/ 'di ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gag cing tha mal gyi rlung sems rnams dbu mar sdud pa'i thabs dam pa'o/ /rtog med kyi phyogs la ni las rgya dang mnyam par sbyor bas nor bur thig le g.yo med du bcings pas sa rlung sogs ches 'gags pa'o/ /de yan chad srog rtsol gyi yan lag go/ //gnyis pa ni/ de ltar dbugs bkag stong pa'i yan lag bsgoms pa la brten nas/ log pa'i sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams 'gags te/ ma log pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba las byung ba'i khams lnga'i snang ba 'char ba ni/ smig sgyu lta bu dang*/ du ba dang*/ srin bu me khyer dang*/ mar me g.yo ba med pa dang/ nam mkha' sprin med lta bu ste/ rtags lnga 'byung ngo*/ /rtags snang de dag brtan pa thob thob kyi bar du yan lag snga ma bsgom zhing*/ brtan pa thob nas de lta bu'i rtags snang de nyid la sems rtse gcig tu gzung ba'o/

/'di la ni rtog bcas dang rtog med kyi dbye ba med de 'dzin pa'i yan lag go/ //gsum pa la rtog pa can gyi dbang du byas te/ rjes su dran pa bcu drug yod kyang*/ rigs mthun bsdu na/ skad cig gis bskyed pa'i rjes dran dang*/ bskyed chog dang bcas pa'i rjes dran dang*/ stong nyid bsgom pa'i rjes dran dang*/ bde chen rjes su dran pa ste bzhi las/ dang po la/ sangs rgyas rjes dran rnam snang*/ chos rjes dran 'od dpag med/ rdo rje rjes dran mi bskyod pa/ rigs rjes dran rin 'byung don 'grub yum bzhi sems dpa' yab yum dang bcas pa dang*/ khro bo rjes dran gshin rje gshed la sogs pa ste/ de dag kyang sngar gyi nor bu'i thig le dang phyogs mthun pa las/ byang chub kyi sems zhu ba rdo rje nor bu nas phyir spros te/ skad cig gis rnam snang dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir byung nam mkha' thams cad khyab/ tha mal gyi snod bcud thams cad sbyangs te/ rnam snang 'ba' zhig tu gyur bar bsam pa sogs lhag ma rnams la yang sbyar te/ de ltar na skad cig gis bskyed pa'i rjes dran lnga'o/ /gnyis pa la/ dam tshig rjes dran ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las/ thabs kyi byang chub kyi sems phyag mtshan dang sa bon dpag tu med par gyur te/ sbyor mtshams nas phyir spros/ nam mkha' khyab pa sogs sngar bzhin bsgom dkyil 'khor rjes dran ni/ snying ga'i thig le sngar bzhin bsgoms pa'i rjes su/ sgrub thabs nas bshad pa bzhin dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha rnams spros/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa rnams la ye shes pa spyan drangs te bstim pa'o/ /sku rjes su dran pa dang*/ gsung rjes su dran pa dang*/ thugs rjes su dran pa gsum ni/ dkyil 'khor rjes dran gyi rim pas/ snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor bsgoms nas/ de thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlabs pa sgrub pa'i yan lag ni sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin sgom pa'o/

/sems can rjes su dran pa ni/ sems can thams cad lhag pa'i lhar gsal btab nas de rnams kyis rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlab pa sngar bzhin bsgom pa'o/ /sngags thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs spyi'i rjes dran ni/ byang chub sems phyi rol tu spros pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las nam mkha' nas bar do'i rnam shes yi ge lnga 'bebs pa nas brtsams te/ thams cad la rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bskyed chog gi dmigs pa rgyas par bsgom pa'o/ /mchod pa'i dam tshig rjes dran ni/ dkyil 'khor rjes dran snga ma bzhin du bsgoms te/ byang chub sems kyi thig le spros pa las byung ba'i mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams bskyed chog sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin bya ba yin no/ /de ltar na bskyed chog dang 'brel ba'i rjes dran brgyad do/ /gsum pa la gnyis las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig rjes dran ni/ thog mar dkyil 'khor rjes dran ltar snang ba thams cad lhar gsal btab ste/ de thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi snang ba yang bsdus te/ dbyings rig dbyer med kyi stong nyid zab pa'i lta ba gtso bor sgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ma skyes pa'i rjes su dran pa ni/ de lta bu'i zab pa de nyid kyang gsal bar byas te stong nyid sgom pa dkyil 'khor gyi snang ba yang ma 'gags la/ de la yang rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid sgom pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ zhe sdang gi rigs la sogs pa'i mchod pa rjes su dran pa gcig pu yin te/ dngos sam ye shes ṛg ma bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi bar pa skor bzhi'i bskyed chog gis bskyed de/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ rjes chags kyi bde ba bsgoms te bde ba des snang ba thams cad la rgyas 'debs pa'o/ /de ltar na rjes su dran pa bcu drug po 'di dag rgyas par 'di nyid ston pa'i rgyud kyi tshig rnams las shes dgos shing*/

'di dag ni rdzogs rim la bskyed rim gyis rgyas btab pa yin no gsungs/ 'on kyang rjes dran 'di dag gsal snang dngos su skyes pa'i dbang du byas na/ rdzogs rim gyi lha snang 'ba' zhig yin la/ dang po'i las can gyis sgom pa'i dbang du byas na'ang*/ rjes dran dang po lnga dang*/ bcu bzhi pa dang*/ bco lnga pa rnams rdzogs rim pa'i lha sku sgom par 'gyur zhing*/ lhag ma rnams ni/ bskyed rim gyis rdzogs rim la rgyas btab par yang 'gyur bar snang ngo*/ /rtog bral gyi phyogs la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga 'gags pa'i gsal snang gi dkyil 'khor ni rjes dran dang po lnga dang*/ dam tshig gnyis dang dkyil 'khor rjes dran ni las rgya kho na la brten pa ste rtsa phran gyi thig phran dang 'khor lo rnams kyi thig le dang phung khams kyi rlung rnams thim pa'i lhar snang ngo*/ /thig le dwangs pas sku'i snang ba dang*/ khrag thim pas sgra'i snang ba dang*/ rlung thim pas mngon shes sogs gsal snang dang*/ phyi rol gyi snang ba'i dod du gsal snang gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ rang gzhan mnyam nyid kyi gsal snang rnams sku sogs lnga dang*/ bde stong ches brtan pa dang*/ bde ba de lhar shar ba dang*/ nyams sam 'od kyi rig mas bde ba 'dren pa ste 'di gsum ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rjes dran sogs so/ /de ltar na rjes dran gyi yan lag go/ //gsum pa dga' bral sprul pa'i thig le sgom pa la rjes mthun pa bskyed rim la brten pa dang*/ dngos 'bras bu'i tshul du shar ba gnyis las dang po la/ rten phyag rgya bzhin dgod pa dang brten pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba'o/ /dang po ni gzhi lus skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i dpral ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus kyi thad du/ sku rdo rje'i thugs kar rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam la oṃ dkar po las kyi phyag rgya'i ngo bo/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i thugs kar me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum la āḥdamar po chos kyi phyag rgya'i ngo bo/

snying gar thugs rdo rje'i thugs kar chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po la hūṃ sngon po phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo/ de gnyis kyang longs spyod 'khor lo dang chos 'khor gyi thad kar sgom mo thugs rdo rje'i gong tsam du rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi la hūṃ sngon po'am maṃ dmar ser dam tshig phyag rgya'i ngo bo ste/ de rnams la re re bzhin du sems drag tu gzung zhing*/ mthar bzhi car la mnyam par bzhag gnyis pa la/ rdor bzlas gyi gzhi nges par bya ba dang*/ rdor bzlas dngos so/ /dang po ni/ dpral ba'i oṃ rlung nang du 'ong ba'i ngo bo/ mgrin pa'i āḥrlung gnas pa'i ngo bo/ snying ga'i hūṃ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i ngo bo/ snying ga'i stod kyi maṃ yig 'gro 'ong gnas gsum dang bral ba'i ngo bor yang yang mos pa bya ba ni dmigs skor gcig yang rlung phyir dbyung ba'i tshe hūṃ yig dran zhing snod kyi 'jig rten dag par byas par bsam/ rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe oṃ yig dran zhing*/ nang bcud kyi sems can dag par byas par bsam/ gnas pa'i tshe āḥyig dran zhing*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes skyes par bsam ste dmigs skor gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la/ g.yas nas rgyu ba rlung gi dkyil 'khor mnyam gnas kyi rdor bzlas/ g.yon nas rgyu ba chu'i dkyil 'khor srog 'dzin gyi rdor bzlas/ gnyis ka nas drag tu rgyu ba me'i dkyil 'khor gyen rgyu'i rdor bzlas/ gnyis ka nas dal bar rgyu ba sa'i dkyil 'khor thur sel gyi rdor bzlas te bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sna bug g.yas nas rlung rgyu ba'i tshe/ rlung gi rlung dud kha dpral ba'i rlung dang ngo bo gcig par mos te/ dpral ba nas brtsams/ sna sgo rgyud 'gro 'ong byed par mos la/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe/ dpral ba'i rlung las hūṃ gi gdangs can rlung gi rlung kha dog nag po g.yas kyi sna bug nas phyir song*/

snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyi dri ma sbyangs shing gsal bar byas/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe oṃ gyi gdangs dang bcas sngar gyi lam nas 'ongs pa na/ snod bcud thams cad kyi dngas ma rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur bsdus te/ rang rgyud kyi dri ma thams cad bkrus par bsam/ gnas pa'i tshe bdud rtsi de yang rten gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor la bstim zhing/ āḥyig gi gdangs la sems bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ de nyid dang 'dra ba las snying ga'i chu'i dkyil 'khor nas kha dog dkar po'i rnam pas 'gro 'ong byed par bsams te bzlas so/ /gsum pa ni/ rten gzhi mgrin pa'i me nas kha dog dmar po'i tshul gyis bzlas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ snying ga'i stod kyi sa'i dkyil 'khor nas 'od zer ser po'i rnam pas bzlas so/ /'di dag la 'jug gnas ldang gsum cha mnyam du byas pas rim gyi gnas pa je ring du 'gro bas/ ched du dgag mi dgos zhes bla ma mang po dag gsung la/ gzhung gi bstan bya'i gtso bo ni lam snga ma rnams kyi rtogs pa sngon song gi dbang du byas pas phyogs gcig nas de bzhin du yang snang mod/ don ji lta ba ni ma go bar snang ngo*/ /'on kyang da ltar las dang po las 'di dag sgom pa na/ gnas pa'i tshe bum can brtan par 'dzin pa dang*/ phyir dbyung ba'i tshe thur sel cung zad steng du 'dren pa ni man ngag las 'byung ba ste shin tu legs pa'ang yin/ de dag la legs par bslabs pa las/ man ngag gi bzlas pa zhes bya ba 'grub pa'ang yin no/ /snang ba thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ ngag thams cad grags stong du shes pa'i sgo nas/ snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i a snang stong la ring du 'jog pa ni/ don dam pa'i rdor bzlas so/ /de ltar na rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'di nyid la gnas bzhin pas las kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes sgom pa na/ chags pa dang*/ chags bral dang*/ chags pa bar ma'i rtog pa rnams rim gyi skye zhing*/

rlung 'byung 'jug gnas pa thams cad dang bral bas sgra thams cad nam mkha' la dengs par 'gro ba yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos 'bras bu'i tshul du 'char ba ni rlung dang thig le nang du 'ong ba yas babs kyi dga' ba gsum/ gnas pa na lhan skyes/ phyir 'gro ba mas brtan dga' ba gsum/ phyi rol tu gnas pa mas brtan lhan skyes rnams rlung dang thig le dang*/ rtags snang gcig tu bsres te sgom pa yin/ de yang gtso bor las rgya la brten nas sgrub pa'o/ /'di las rgod pa glal ba dang brgyal ba la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung ste dus 'khor ba'i rjes dran dang dod mtshungs so/ /gnyis pa la yang brdas mtshon pa dang*/ don mngon gyur gnyis kyi dang po la/ rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skad cig tsam gyis bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi gsum tshang bar bsgoms skad pa la/ 'di ni rnal 'byor rab kyi dbang du byas pa yin pas/ de tsam na yud kyi gsal thebs pa yin mod kyi/ las dang po pas/ dmigs 'khrid 'di sgom pa'i tshe ni/ bskyed rim rgyas pa ma tshang ba med pa sgom pa ka yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro bogs 'don gyi chos gsum dang*/ dngos gzhi spro bsdu bya ba'o/ /dang po ni rten bskyed rim la brten de/ snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i thig le'i dkyil 'khor gsum sbrag bogs 'don sbyangs bsdus bskur gsum dang bcas pa gong bzhin sgom pa las/ bogs 'don gsum pa'i skabs kyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems so so'i thugs kar yi ge kṣ+ruṃ gyi rnam par gyur nas bsdu ba ni khyad par ro/ /de la kṣ+ruṃ zhes pa'i ka ṣa ra u ma ste/ yi ge lnga ni ye shes lnga'i ngo bor mos pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa la bsdu spro bsdu gsum las/ dang po ni phyi snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i bsrung 'khor la thim/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de lha bco brgyad la/

de dam tshig sems pa la/ de ye shes sems pa la/ de ral gri la/ de maṃ yig zhu ba'i thig le la thim/ dkyil 'khor gsum sbrag tu bsgoms yod na thig le de'i nang gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ de yang nang gi dkyil 'khor rnams snga ma'i rim pas bsdu/ mthar stong pa'i dbus su thig le nyag cig la sems 'jog pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ thig le de las 'od byung ral gri nas brtsams te sngar thim rim rnams lugs bzlog gi rim pas dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bskyed la/ snang ba thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor blta'o/ /de thams cad kyang 'od zer gyis khyab cing 'ja' tshon lta bu yal yal ba la sems gtad cing mthar zab gsal gnyis su med pa bsgom/ gsum pa ni/ sngar bzhin bsdus la thig le yang je phra je phra la sems gtad/ 'di nyid yang dang yang du sgom par byas pas 'od gsal sgrub par byed la/ dmigs pa de nyid kyis spro bsdu spro gsum byas na lha sku dam pa mngon du 'gyur te las dang po dang thun mong yin no/ /gnyis pa don mngon gyur ni/ gsal snang dkyil 'khor la mnyam par bzhag pas bde ba skye zhing*/ des ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gags nas bde chen gcig pur 'gyur la/ de skabs bde ba la mnyam par bzhag pas yang gsal snang mched 'gro ba na gsal snang de la bsgoms/ yang bde chen skyes pa na gnyis snang 'gags pa ste de ltar sgom mo/ /de nas spyod pa spyad pas chags chen gyi sa bcu gnyis mngon du byas nas don dam pa'i ye shes thob ste/ bcu gsum pa zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pa yin no/ /'dir yang bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyis rgyas btab pa yin/ de dag ni ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ste/ dga' bral skor rnams ting nge 'dzin gyi dngos gyi sbyor ba dang lhan skyes skor rnams ting nge 'dzin dngos yin no/ /gsum pa zab gsal gnyis med kyi spyod pas bogs 'byin pa ni/ 'di la gsang ste spyod pa dang*/

'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod pa gnyis yod pa las/ de dag gi rnam gzhag gzhan du blta bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bar do la sogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gsum ste/ 'pho ba dang*/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang*/ rmi lam lha sku'o/ /dang po la rgyu'i chos gsum bsten pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i chos gsum 'grub pa'o/ /dang po la sgo dgag pa/ gnas btsal ba/ dbyings su 'pho ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i lte ba/ smin mtshams/ spyi bo/ mig rna ba/ sna bug kha sgo rnams su hūṃ yig sngon po re re/ chu lam du suṃ yig dkar po/ bshang lam du kṣuṃ yig dmar po/ de dag gi 'od zer 'thug pos sgo rnams bkag par bsams la rlung bum pa can drag tu bzung zhing bsgoms/ sgo rnams khegs pa'i rtags byung ngam ma byung rung zla drug bsgoms na sgo rnams khegs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni sngar bzhin gsal btab nas/ rang gi phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi/ mig sogs sems dpa' drugagazugs sogs lha mo drug tu mos par bya/ gang du 'pho ba'i gnas rang gi spyi bor rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa/ 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba/ de'i lte bar yang chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ snga ma'i bcu cha tsam zhig gsal btab/ rtse dgu po rigs lnga yab yum gyi ngo bor mos rdo rje gnyis ka'ang gyen du langs pa'i rnam pa can/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la zla ba'i steng du thig le sngon po'am dmar ser/ rnam pa byang chub kyi sems tsa na ka lnga sdoms pa'i tshad tsam/ dbyibs zlum po/ ngo bo zab gsal dbyer med 'od zer sna lnga 'bar ba cig bsgom/ gsum pa ni/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang*/ snang ba thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor skad cig tsam zhig bsgoms/ de thams cad rang gi sems snang yin snyam du 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/

thams cad rim gyis sam gcig car snying ga'i thig le la thim/ thig le de nyid dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud de spyi bo tshangs bug nas thon/ rdo rje rim pa gnyis kyi 'og gi rwa dbus ma'i sbubs nas zhugs te/ rwa lnga pa'i lte ba'i thig le la thim/ rang lus dkyil 'khor gtso bor gsal ba yang rdo rje rtse dgu pa la thim/ de yang rtse lnga pa la thim/ de yang thig le la thim/ de yang ta la bdun srid tsam du nam mkha' la 'phags te/ de nyid je phrar je phrar song ba'i ngang nas/ 'od gsal stong nyid kyi ngang du thim/ der 'dzin med la ring du mnyam par bzhag chos sku thob par mos pa cung zad bya/ de'i ngang nas lha sku zab gsal gnyis med du bskyed/ longs spyod rdzogs skur nga rgyal cung zad bya/ spro na dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi rim pa dang 'brel bar snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor bsgom/ de tsam mi lcogs na rang nyid las dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa sprul te/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod par bsams la/ sprul pa'i sku'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu'i chos gsum ni/ dbang po rab kyis 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor 'di 'ba' zhig gis sku gsung thugs mngon du byed pa dang*/ 'bring bar do/ /tha ma'ang rig pa 'dzin pa grub pa'am skye ba bdun nas 'grub pa'o/ /gnyis pa gnyid kyi 'od gsal ni/ snying ga'i sems pa gsum brtseg gi thig le dang*/ nor bu'i thig le dang*/ rdor bzlas rnams gang rung zhig bsgoms nas nyin mo 'dun pa rgyun chags dang*/ mtshan mo dmigs pa drag tu gtad pas gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'char ro/ /gsum pa rmi lam lha sku ni/ nyin par gyi skabs su do nub rmi lam gyi dus su 'di dran par bya'o zhes 'dun pa dang bcas pas 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa gsum gang rigs sngon du btang nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las lha skur ldang ba'o/ /'dis dang po dmigs pa dran pa tsam dang*/

bar du lhar 'gyur ba dang*/ mthar lha sku rang shar 'byung ngo*/ /de nas 'khor lo so so'i sems pa gsum brtseg gi 'od zer spro bsdus bogs 'don te/ rmi lam nyid kyi rtsal 'don na mgrin pa dang*/ sgyu mar sbyong na spyi bo dang*/ 'od gsal 'dod na snying ga dang*/ bde ba 'dod na lte bar bsgom mo/ /de ltar lam sgom tshul bstan zin no/ /'bras bu sku gsum ni/ chos sku la rab dga' mkha' mnyam/ longs sku la dpe med bde rdzogs/ sprul sku la sna tshogs gzugs brnyan zhes gsung ngo*/ de ltar na/ thig le dang po'i rnal 'byor la dmigs chen bzhi/ gnyis pa la bcu dgu/ gsum pa la drug bzhi pa la gnyis/ 'pho ba ste dmigs chen sum cu so gnyis so/ /de ltar dmigs 'khrid skyong ba'i skabs dkyil 'khor gsum sbrag sogs sgom dka' bas de'i skabs su sems pa gsum brtseg tshar re res chog go /'di dag gi go don lam rim rgyas pa ni/ zhal lung dang*/ grol thig rtsa 'grel/ sgrub thabs kun bzang dang dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa 'grel par bcas pa las shes par bya zhing*/ mdo tsam kho bos kyang 'bri bar 'gyur ba srid do/ /rgyud kun rgyal po gsang 'dus rab dga'i rtser/ /man ngag snying po'i rin chen legs bkod pa/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dus/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog gis lan brgyar bsgrengs/ /de lta mod kyi lam 'di la/ /mchog tu gus pas nyid drangs nas/ /thos bsam sgom pas 'dris bya ste/ /mdo tsam yi ge'i lam du bkod/ /'di las dge ba gang thob des/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can rnams/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje ye shes sku/ /bla med thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gal te mi bskyod rdo rje la sogs pa la mos na de dang de'i dkyil 'khor la brten te phyag mtshan dang*/ sa bon dang*/ thig le'i kha dog sogs bsgyur na/ 'khrid tshul 'di kho nas 'grub pa'i phyir/

zhabs lugs kyi mi bskyod pa sogs rigs lnga so so'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs sogs la'ang 'khrid tshul gzhan du bsam mi dgos so/ /de ltar na grol ba'i thig le'i khrid yig mi shigs pa rin po che sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer dgu pa la dpal jo mo nang du sbyar ba'o// //zhus dag maṅga laṃ/ bha wandu/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal grol ba'i thig le'i khrid yig mi shigs pa'i rin po che sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 260--PAGE 259--PAGE 236-
